entry.title: Render real furigana as ruby, with a click-only toggle
entry.content:
Render real furigana as ruby, with a click-only toggle

Decks now build from src/ rather than md/, so the {f|kanji|kana} macro
survives as <ruby> instead of being flattened to parenthesised readings.
deckrun's leading leaves no room above a line, so the deck carries its own
line-height and rt sizing; headings drop the readings, where tight leading
would collide and the term is furigana'd in the body moments later.

The toggle is deliberately click-only, leaving every key free for presenting,
and remembers the choice per browser so it holds across chapters.

entry.title: Add a persistent back link from every deck page to the index
entry.content:
Add a persistent back link from every deck page to the index

A chapter page was a dead end: deckrun's own chrome carries no way out. The
link is a fixed overlay outside the slide canvas, so it survives navigation,
and it is hidden in print so it stays out of PDF exports.
